stories.headline: Nations agree on new global carbon reduction targets
stories.summary: Major economies commit to ambitious new climate goals, signaling renewed global cooperation to combat climate change.

stories.headline: Leading AI firm unveils next-gen multimodal foundation model
stories.summary: A major tech company launched an advanced AI model, promising significant leaps in human-computer interaction and various industries.

stories.headline: European Central Bank raises interest rates to curb inflation
stories.summary: The ECB increased key interest rates to combat persistent inflation across the Eurozone, impacting borrowing costs and economic growth.

stories.headline: New malaria vaccine shows high efficacy in final trials
stories.summary: A novel vaccine candidate demonstrated significant protection against malaria in Phase 3 trials, offering hope for millions in endemic regions.

stories.headline: Protests erupt in Southeast Asian capital over new austerity measures
stories.summary: Thousands took to the streets in a major Asian city, protesting government-imposed austerity measures expected to hit low-income families hard.
